title: Kernel is_def_eq cache depended on the order of checks
summary: The kernel's definitional-equality cache gave answers that depended on the order in which checks ran, which was enough to get bogus proofs accepted. Found in the Lean FRO's bug hunt after lean-0001; nanoda and ind-models both rejected the bogus proofs.

links.label: Checked by Tenet, tenet-hs and tenet-jvm (independent kernels)
